plugins.name: annetaan
plugins.description: Claude Code skills from Annetaan Inc. Holds workflow, which runs one implementation as design, approval, per-task implement and review rounds, an integration review when there is more than one task, and a finish step that resolves any conflict with the base under review and opens a pull request, all in a worktree of its own. It also resolves the conflicts of a pull request that is already open, when you ask in plain words. Also pj1-plan, pj2-issues, pj3-doctor and pj4-running, which run a larger piece of work as projects on GitHub. pj1-plan cuts the work into projects with the dependencies between them, and pj2-issues splits one project into tasks, one sub-issue each, once the projects it waits on are merged. From there the work goes through decisions you tick on GitHub and pj3-doctor's review of the whole project to one merged pull request per sub-issue through pj4-running, and a pull request that brings the whole project back for you to merge. pj-auto drives pj3-doctor and pj4-running on a project until it needs you, and pj-cleanup closes the project, removes its worktree and branch, and brings your branch up to date once you have merged it, and workflow-cleanup does the same for a workflow run. pj-roadmap brings the repository's roadmap file into the format the pj skills read, through a pull request. And doc-write, which writes a document in plain words that says each thing once and in order, and doc-meta, doc-review and doc-revise, which let you flag sentences in a document with an opinion and have the document revised to match. And experience-video, which interviews you about your customer's experience and renders a video of under one minute from it.
